title: Editor: Noa Kamil
article: Noa, a 12 year old athlete, enjoys playing sports and traveling! She is half Korean and half Israeli and is almost fluent in 3 languages! She has been to lots of states in the USA and also been to South Korea and Israel! Noa plays ice hockey, is a black belt in taekwondo, and plays the cello! She also loves art. Noa hopes she can write as an adult in the future and this is a start!
author: Noa Kamil
